purpose: One finite checkpoint: genuine free discovery and faithful descriptive reporting first; precision/detection sensitivity and measured resource cost without scientific admission.

input_scope.delay_basis: Existing assumed scenario, not verified historical publication
input_scope.rights: Existing retained provider documents; personal non-production exploration only; recheck exact compiled data-use qualification before execution
input_scope.exposure: Development history is exposed; model training exposure unknown; no independence claim

exploration.isolation: Same frozen base snapshot, sequential, no peer transcript before both submit
exploration.ideas: One freely invented primary idea per perspective; no canned condition or outcome. Unsupported meanings are retained. Preserve every intermediate record and failure.
exploration.profile_qualification: Same-provider exploratory probe permitted by contract section 9. Does not replace the requested future mixed-provider full cycle. No provider fallback.
exploration.selection: Both perspectives are attempted; both ideas enter formalization and independent meaning review in perspective order if their own prerequisites and original shared budgets permit. No outcome-based candidate selection.
exploration.execution: Only a structurally executable, independently reviewed faithful candidate with qualified development use may run. Preserve gaps; no silent repair of meaning. Descriptive execution first, no scientific classification.
exploration.stop: Original epoch cap, unavailable credential or budget, missing stage prerequisite, or unusable response; no fresh epoch to rescue a target. At most two bounded integration corrections for a diagnosed infrastructure problem, preserving original attempts and caps.

preparation.method: Reuse existing retained monthly development sources, normalizer, raw-feature and reference certification. Narrow the declared data container before observing new results to reduce provenance context size, preserving exact raw ancestry and qualifications. No new data model or simulator.
preparation.stop: If required preparation cannot finish within the cap, retain the exact stage gap. Do not expand infrastructure.

precision_sensitivity.status: DECLARED; execute after the independently permitted exploratory work
precision_sensitivity.model: Existing response-mask population law, estimator-only synthetic stress, not a fitted original-market-process law
precision_sensitivity.order: Ascending timestamp count, repetition, then effect; retain every planned and unrun slot
precision_sensitivity.condition_and_missingness: Reuse the existing source-template marginal condition/missingness rates with declared mask mean block 8; report exact source values and generated values separately
precision_sensitivity.claim_family_qualification: Two declared synthetic response components; not a fabricated claim count for the genuine ideas
precision_sensitivity.bootstrap: Existing 19999 draws at each half/base/double length, base 8, joint instrument rows and unchanged estimator/undefined-draw handling
precision_sensitivity.report: Every completed interval, coverage and detection against the declared practical boundary; exact count uncertainty by complete cell, failed/unrun cells and model limitations. Two worlds cannot establish useful power or final calibration. Null-only width is not power.
precision_sensitivity.stop: Budget exhaustion or existing capability bound closes this component with a retained gap; no simulator expansion or selective rerun

resource_measurement: Measure actual preparation, exploratory execution, synthetic calculation and replay separately, including retained bytes and backup overhead. Full-year and 256-world projections are qualified estimates from measured work, not observed full-year performance.
economics: For each real idea state the mapping from descriptive estimand to an economic claim or its absence. Use explicitly hypothetical round-trip cost stress at 0, 10, 20 and 40 basis points; never present these as current account tariffs. Missing policy/fill/fee inputs remain missing, and a probability effect alone does not establish profit.
unfinished_second_order: Preserved, not a prerequisite and not expanded in this checkpoint
checkpoint_exit: Record informative/affordable, measured bottleneck, proposed scientific-profile change, or precise retained gap. Do not alter accepted thresholds, partitions, retention or scientific gates.
